authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant AI generation artifacts. While the upper bodies and heads of the giraffes are reasonably well-defined with correct ossicones and neck proportions, the lower bodies suffer from severe structural collapse. The legs of adjacent giraffes merge into each other and the background, creating a fused mass effect where individual limb definition is lost. Additionally, the suitcase wheels appear melted into the ground with inconsistent contact shadows, and some handles show geometric warping. The texture on the giraffes is unnaturally repetitive and smooth, resembling a tiled texture map rather than natural variation. These structural defects significantly reduce authenticity.
